mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in residential construction permits below 1.1 million units signals weakening housing demand, which acts as a leading indicator of broader consumer spending slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% combined with a rising CPIAUCSL trend signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL rising > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite signal, or the interaction-based Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.0 index level signals a contraction in real economic output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 450 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction-based Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market recovery, which increases consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rising > 100k in 3 months AND UNRATE falling > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction-based Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A stable federal funds rate below 0.5% combined with a flat or declining CPIAUCSL indicates disinflationary pressures, which signal a lack of inflation risk and support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL flat or falling > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction-based Rank IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized rate signals strong underlying economic growth, which increases corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
